title: Generic Archipelago Rules JSON Schema
description: Generic schema for rules.json files, adaptable for various games.

schema_version.description: Version of the rules.json schema itself.

game_directory.description: The world directory name for the game.

archipelago_version.description: Version of Archipelago used to generate the game.

generation_seed.description: The seed used for game generation.

sphere_log.description: Optional embedded sphere log — same shape as a *_sphere_log.jsonl file's lines. Used as a fallback by the loader when no separate sphere log file is present. Procgen-emitted; not present in vanilla Archipelago output.

player_names.description: Mapping of player slot ID (string) to player name.

world_classes.description: Mapping of player slot ID (string) to the world class name used.

regions.description: Region data, keyed by player slot ID (string).

^[0-9]+$.description: Region definitions for a player, keyed by region name. Typically includes a 'Menu' region.

dungeons.description: Dungeon data, keyed by player slot ID (string). Optional.

^[0-9]+$.description: Dungeon definitions for a player, keyed by dungeon name.

start_regions.description: Start region configurations, keyed by player slot ID (string).

items.description: Item definitions, keyed by player slot ID (string).

^[0-9]+$.description: Item definitions for a player, keyed by item name.

item_groups.description: List of item group names, keyed by player slot ID (string).

itempool_counts.description: Counts of each item in the player's item pool, keyed by player slot ID (string).

^[0-9]+$.description: Mapping of item name to its count in the pool.

progression_mapping.description: Mapping for progressive items, keyed by player slot ID (string). Optional.

^[0-9]+$.description: Progressive item definitions for a player, keyed by the base progressive item name.

starting_items.description: List of starting items for each player, keyed by player slot ID (string).

world.description: World data mirroring Archipelago's world structure, keyed by player slot ID (string). Contains game name, options, runtime attributes, slot_data, and web metadata.

game.description: Name of the game this world is for.

slot_data.description: Data from world.fill_slot_data() sent to the client.

world_description.description: World class docstring describing the game.

exporter.description: Exporter-specific settings, keyed by player slot ID (string). Contains processing flags and metadata not from the Archipelago world.

rule_format.description: Version metadata for the exported rules.

assume_bidirectional_exits.description: Whether region connections are bidirectional by default.

use_resolved_items.description: Whether to use resolved items in event processing.

settings.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'world' instead. Kept for backwards compatibility.

game.description: Name of the game these settings apply to.

game_info.description: Game-specific information and accumulator patterns, keyed by player slot ID (string). Contains custom game data that doesn't fit in world/exporter sections.

accumulator_rules.description: Rules for computing accumulated values (e.g., coin counts).

prog_items_init.description: Initial values for progressive item accumulators.

helpers.description: Helper function definitions, keyed by player slot ID (string).

^[0-9]+$.description: Helper definitions for a player, keyed by helper name.

seed_name.description: The seed name string for this generation.

is_vanilla.description: Whether item placements match the original non-randomized game. True for games where items are in their designed/intended locations.

is_canonical.description: Whether item placements are deterministically reproduced by the world generator. True for worldgen worlds generated with --canonical-seed.

canonical_placements.description: Canonical item placements for deterministic seed generation, keyed by player slot ID (string).

^[0-9]+$.description: Mapping of location name to placed item name.

playerId.description: Player slot ID (string) of a PLAYER-SPECIFIC export; absent from the combined multiworld document. Producer: exporter/exporter.py:2864-2866 (value from :3024, `player_str`).

preset_label.description: Short label shown on this preset's frontend button (e.g. 'canth s4'). Producer: exporter/exporter.py:1391-1396, copied from the first player world declaring a `preset_label` class attribute (world_generator/_template_init.py:688-694).

assume_bidirectional_exits.description: When true, every back-exit inherits its paired forward exit's rule, and consumers may construct back-exits that the document does not list. Producer: frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/procgenPipelineEngine.js:6292 (the top-level flag; the exporter's same-named `exporter_settings` field, exporter/games/base/handler.py:1817-1820, is a DIFFERENT, nested field).

preset_sidecars.description: Per-region playable payloads for procgen substrates, keyed by player slot ID (string). Producers: exporter/exporter.py:1073 (the empty `{}` every export carries), exporter/games/base/handler.py:2102 (the worldgen `_worldgen_sidecars.json` round-trip), frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/procgenPipelineEngine.js:6331 (`buildPresetSidecars`, defined at :6053) and frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/regionAtlasCompiler.js:722.

^[0-9]+$.description: Mapping of region name to that region's sidecar entry — keyed exactly like this player's `regions` block.

procgen_metadata.description: How this document was procedurally generated. Producers: frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/procgenPipelineEngine.js:6351 (which merges the caller's block with the auto-derived `region_count` and `grid_dims`), whose callers supply the rest — procgenPipeline/sphereSteps.js:491 and procgenPipeline/topDownSteps.js:134 — and exporter/games/base/handler.py:2135 (the worldgen `_worldgen_procgen_metadata.json` round-trip). Open-ended by construction: the caller's fields are spread in, so consumers must tolerate unlisted ones.

driver.description: Which pipeline driver built the world — 'sphere-growth' (sphereSteps.js:492), 'top-down' or 'top-down-sphere' (topDownSteps.js:135).

stop_reason.description: Why grid growth stopped, from the driver's own stats.

region_count.description: Number of generated regions. Auto-derived by procgenPipelineEngine.js:6351, never caller-supplied.

grid_dims.description: Bounding size of the generated grid in cells. Auto-derived by procgenPipelineEngine.js:6353-6356 from the maximum `grid_cell`.

source_game.description: Name of the source world a top-down build was derived from. Producer: procgenPipeline/topDownSteps.js:136.

source_counts.description: Item/location tallies of the source world a top-down build consumed. Producer: procgenPipeline/topDownSteps.js:137 (`computeSourceCounts`).

sphere_plan.description: Compact per-sphere plan the driver executed. Producers: procgenPipeline/sphereSteps.js:494 and topDownSteps.js:142; read back by `rebuildEnvelopeFromRulesJson` (procgenPipelineEngine.js:4072-4078).

sphere_tree.description: Compact region-to-wave attribution — the abstract topology without the grid. Producer: procgenPipeline/topDownSteps.js:142; read back by `rebuildEnvelopeFromRulesJson`.

edits.description: Recorded hand edits to the generated grid, kept as provenance. Producers: procgenPipeline/sphereSteps.js and topDownSteps.js:141 (omitted entirely when nothing was edited).

loop_costs.description: Loop-mode mana economy for this world. Producers: frontend/modules/shared/procgen/loopCostGenerator.js:134-146 (`generateLoopCosts`, invoked from procgenPipelineEngine.js:6412), exporter/games/base/handler.py:2171 (the worldgen `_worldgen_loop_costs.json` round-trip) and the hand-written test-preset writers under scripts/test/generate-*-preset.*. Consumed by frontend/modules/loops/costDataManager.js.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:136.

generatedFrom.description: Name of the source file the costs were simulated from. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:137.

regions.description: Region name -> cost entry. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:186-194 and :316-330.

moveCost.description: Mana charged for entering this region. The EXPLICIT per-region cost costDataManager.js:368-371 reads.

timeDrainPerSecond.description: Mana drained per second of live play — how SUMMARY substrates (runner, bounce) are priced instead of per action.

locations.description: Location name -> mana cost. The values are NUMBERS, not objects (loopCostGenerator.js:204, :342; read at costDataManager.js:346-348).

defaultRegionCost.description: Fallback move cost for regions `regions` does not name. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:144 (default 50).

defaultLocationCost.description: Fallback check cost for locations `locations` does not name. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:145 (default 10).

defaultRegionXpEffect.description: Fallback XP effect mode for regions that state none. Producer: loopCostGenerator.js:146.

error.description: Set instead of real costs when generation threw — costDataManager.js:209 skips a block carrying it. Producer: procgenPipelineEngine.js:6422-6430.

region_atlas.description: Which region atlas this document's graph was compiled from. Producer: frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/regionAtlasCompiler.js:564-568.

atlas_id.description: The atlas's stamped id; it ends in the atlas content hash, so a restamped atlas visibly invalidates a stale preset.

map_document.description: Path of the tile-space map document the atlas was marked on. Omitted when the atlas declares no tile space.

flash_panel.description: Wiring that boots the recompiled original game for this preset in the Flash panel. Producers: frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/regionAtlasCompiler.js:720 (from the FLASH_PANEL_WIRING table at :148, the only CODE source of this block) and frontend/modules/tileMapAnalyzer/rulesExporter.js:350-355. Blocks in hand-authored presets are provisional (flashPanel/README.md).

config.description: Panel config file name for the game.

wasm.description: Path of the recompiled WASM build's page (e.g. 'seedling_bot_ap_p4d/game.html').

swf.description: Injected SWF file name, for games still booted from Flash. Producer: tileMapAnalyzer/rulesExporter.js:353.

provenance.description: OPAQUE — whatever the generator that produced this document wants to say about where it came from; stamped, never derived, so the fields vary per generator. Producer: frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/regionAtlasCompiler.js:561 (passes `options.provenance` through verbatim); frontend/modules/procgenCore/contentIdentity.js:119-133 adds `content_hash` when a document is identity-stamped.

rule.description: A rule object in either AST format (has 'type' field) or Rule Builder format (has 'rule' field).

ruleBuilderRule.description: A Rule Builder rule object. Built-in rules include True_, False_, Has, HasAll, HasAny, HasGroup, HasAllCounts, HasFromList, CountItem, And, Or, CanReachRegion, CanReachLocation, OptionValue, Compare, Conditional, Constant. Game-specific helper rules use arbitrary names.

rule.description: The rule type name (e.g., 'Has', 'And', 'True_') or a game-specific helper name.

args.description: Rule arguments. Object for named args (e.g., {"item_name": "Sword"}), array for positional args.

children.description: Sub-rules for composite rules like 'And' and 'Or'.

_original_ast_type.description: Metadata: the original AST rule type before conversion.

_converted_from_ast.description: Metadata: whether this rule was converted from AST format.

astRule.description: An AST-format rule object defining access conditions.

item.description: Item name or a rule resolving to an item name for 'item_check', 'count_check'.

group.description: Group name or a rule resolving to a group name for 'group_check'.

count.description: Required count for 'count_check', 'group_check', or a rule resolving to a count.

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for 'helper' type. Keys are parameter names, values are rule objects.

if_true.description: Result if test is true for 'conditional'.

if_false.description: Result if test is false for 'conditional'.

element_rule.description: Rule for each element in 'all_of' or 'any_of'.

items.description: Item names or rules for 'counts' type (check if total count of items >= required amount).

shop.description: Shop data if this region contains a shop. Optional.

substrate.description: Optional substrate id telling the procgen top-down driver which substrate to realise this region with (e.g. 'maze', 'text_adventure'). Absent → driver falls back to caller-supplied substrateByRegion / substrateMix / substratePicker, then default 'maze'. Unknown ids pass schema validation but the driver may warn.

id.description: Archipelago Location ID. Null for internally generated locations.

item_rule.description: Rule for the item at this location.

item.description: The item placed at this location.

locked.description: True if the item was placed via place_locked_item at generation time. In procgen-emitted rules.json (procgen_metadata present) this is authored intent: world_generator places the item via place_locked_item so the placement holds even in multiworld fill.

type.description: Item type classification. String or integer depending on exporter version.

locked.description: Whether the shop is initially locked.

region_name.description: Name of the region the shop is in.

location_name.description: Name of the location representing this shop.

item.description: Name of the item for sale.

max.description: Maximum number of this item that can be bought (0 often means unlimited).

replacement.description: Item that replaces this slot after purchase (if any).

regions.description: List of region names belonging to this dungeon.

bosses.description: Boss definitions for this dungeon, keyed by boss position (e.g., 'bottom', 'middle', 'top'). For single-boss dungeons, a single key like 'boss' or 'main' may be used.

medallion_check.description: Rule for checking the medallion requirement for this dungeon.

oneOf.description: Array of Archipelago Item IDs for composite items.

id.description: Archipelago Item ID. Can be a single integer, null, or an array of integers for composite items like pendants and crystals.

advancement.description: Legacy: whether item is progression. Replaced by 'classification' in newer exports.

useful.description: Legacy: whether item is useful. Replaced by 'classification' in newer exports.

trap.description: Legacy: whether item is a trap. Replaced by 'classification' in newer exports.

hint_text.description: Hint text for this item. Optional, only present for some games.

classification_counts.description: Counts per classification when multiple copies of an item exist with different classifications.

oneOf.description: Mapping of item name to count (alternative format used by some games).

base_item.description: The name of the base progressive item.

name.description: Name of the item granted at this level.

level.description: The level of progression this item represents.

provides.description: Other items this level might also grant.

presetSidecarEntry.description: One region's procgen sidecar: which substrate owns the region, how to draw it, where it sits on the driver's grid, and the substrate's own serialized world. Producer: `buildPresetSidecars`, frontend/modules/procgenPipeline/procgenPipelineEngine.js:6106-6129.

substrate.description: Substrate id owning this region (`region.substrate`, defaulting to 'maze'). Resolves through substrateRegistry; measured values across the committed presets: bounce, flash_seedling, jta, maze, omsi, runner, text_adventure.

render_hint.description: How a map renderer should draw this region; defaults to the substrate id when the region declares none.

grid_cell.description: Driver-level layout coordinate, so consumers reproduce the driver's spatial layout instead of running their own force-directed pass. Present only for grid-grown worlds.

playable_payload.description: OPAQUE — the substrate's own serialized world, produced by that substrate's adapter `serializeWorld`. This schema deliberately states no inner shape: the payload belongs to the substrate, not to rules.json.

biome.description: Resolved biome configuration, so regenerating this region can reuse it. Omitted (not null) for substrates with no biome concept.

grow_telemetry.description: Substrate-side auto-grow telemetry from `generateRegionCore`; read by `computeProcgenStats` to surface formula under-provisioning. Omitted when the adapter reported none.
